name: admissions_open
sql: CREATE INDEX admissions_open ON admissions(state, created_at)

name: agents_identity
sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX agents_identity ON agents(node_id, name, ifnull(project_id, ''))

name: deliveries_by_agent
sql: CREATE INDEX deliveries_by_agent ON deliveries(agent_id, read_at)

name: events_by_kind
sql: CREATE INDEX events_by_kind ON events(kind, seq)

name: events_by_node
sql: CREATE INDEX events_by_node ON events(node_id, seq)

name: holds_live
sql: CREATE INDEX holds_live ON holds(project_id, released_at, expires_at)

name: messages_by_thread
sql: CREATE INDEX messages_by_thread ON messages(thread_id, created_at)

name: oauth_tokens_by_grant
sql: CREATE INDEX oauth_tokens_by_grant ON oauth_tokens(grant_id)

name: project_repos_by_key
sql: CREATE INDEX project_repos_by_key ON project_repos(repo_key)

name: requests_by_status
sql: CREATE INDEX requests_by_status ON requests(status, due_at)

name: resource_leases_by_agent
sql: CREATE INDEX resource_leases_by_agent ON resource_leases(agent_id, released_at)

name: resource_leases_by_resource
sql: CREATE INDEX resource_leases_by_resource ON resource_leases(resource_id, released_at)

name: resources_live_identity
sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX resources_live_identity ON resources(node_id, kind, name)
    WHERE released_at IS NULL

name: admission_holds
sql:
CREATE TABLE admission_holds (
    admission_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES admissions(admission_id),
    hold_id      TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES holds(hold_id),
    PRIMARY KEY (admission_id, hold_id)
)

name: admission_secret
sql:
CREATE TABLE admission_secret (
    singleton INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1),
    secret    BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(secret) = 'blob' AND length(secret) = 32)
)

name: admissions
sql:
CREATE TABLE admissions (
    admission_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    node_id      TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nodes(node_id),
    agent_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agents(agent_id),
    correlation  BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(correlation) = 'blob' AND length(correlation) = 32),
    targets      BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(targets) = 'blob' AND length(targets) = 32),
    state        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'confirmed', 'expired')),
    created_at   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    settled_at   INTEGER,
    UNIQUE (node_id, agent_id, correlation)
)

name: agents
sql:
CREATE TABLE agents (
    agent_id     TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    node_id      TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nodes(node_id),
    project_id   TEXT REFERENCES projects(project_id),
    name         TEXT NOT NULL,
    program      TEXT NOT NULL,
    model        TEXT,
    description  TEXT,
    status       TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    updated_at   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    last_seen_at INTEGER,
    event_id     TEXT NOT NULL
, address TEXT)

name: announcements
sql:
CREATE TABLE announcements (
    agent_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agents(agent_id),
    message_id   TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES messages(message_id),
    channel      TEXT NOT NULL,
    announced_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (agent_id, message_id)
)

name: audit_log
sql:
CREATE TABLE audit_log (
    audit_id  INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    node_id   TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nodes(node_id),
    ts        INTEGER NOT NULL,
    token_id  TEXT,
    agent     TEXT,
    operation TEXT NOT NULL,
    outcome   TEXT NOT NULL,
    detail    TEXT,
    remote    TEXT
)

name: deliveries
sql:
CREATE TABLE deliveries (
    message_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES messages(message_id),
    agent_id   TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agents(agent_id),
    node_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nodes(node_id),
    role       TEXT NOT NULL,
    read_at    INTEGER,
    acked_at   INTEGER,
    PRIMARY KEY (message_id, agent_id)
)

name: events
sql:
CREATE TABLE events (
    seq      INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    node_id  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nodes(node_id),
    ts       INTEGER NOT NULL,
    actor    TEXT NOT NULL,
    kind     TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload  TEXT NOT NULL,
    prev_id  TEXT
, sig TEXT)

name: holds
sql:
CREATE TABLE holds (
    hold_id        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    node_id        TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nodes(node_id),
    project_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(project_id),
    agent_id       TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agents(agent_id),
    pattern        TEXT NOT NULL,
    exclusive      INTEGER NOT NULL,
    reason         TEXT,
    ttl_seconds    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    renewed_at     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    expires_at     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    released_at    INTEGER,
    release_reason TEXT
)

name: invites
sql:
CREATE TABLE invites (
    invite_id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    secret_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    perms       TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    expires_at  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    used_at     INTEGER,
    used_by     TEXT
)

name: messages
sql:
CREATE TABLE messages (
    message_id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    node_id      TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nodes(node_id),
    thread_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    reply_to     TEXT REFERENCES messages(message_id),
    sender_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agents(agent_id),
    subject      TEXT NOT NULL,
    body         TEXT NOT NULL,
    importance   TEXT NOT NULL,
    ack_required INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    event_id     TEXT NOT NULL
)

name: nodes
sql:
CREATE TABLE nodes (
    node_id      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    role         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'home',
    is_local     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at   INTEGER NOT NULL
, public_key TEXT, secret_key TEXT)

name: oauth_clients
sql:
CREATE TABLE oauth_clients (
    client_id      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    node_id        TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nodes(node_id),
    client_name    TEXT NOT NULL,
    redirect_uris  TEXT NOT NULL,
    application_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at     INTEGER NOT NULL
)

name: oauth_grants
sql:
CREATE TABLE oauth_grants (
    grant_id      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    node_id       TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nodes(node_id),
    client_id     TEXT NOT NULL,
    client_name   TEXT NOT NULL,
    agent_id      TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agents(agent_id),
    project_globs TEXT NOT NULL,
    label         TEXT,
    resource      TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope         TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    revoked_at    INTEGER,
    last_used_at  INTEGER
)

name: oauth_requests
sql:
CREATE TABLE oauth_requests (
    request_id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    node_id               TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nodes(node_id),
    client_id             TEXT NOT NULL,
    client_name           TEXT NOT NULL,
    redirect_uri          TEXT NOT NULL,
    state                 TEXT,
    scope                 TEXT NOT NULL,
    resource              TEXT NOT NULL,
    code_challenge        TEXT NOT NULL,
    code_challenge_method TEXT NOT NULL,
    user_code             TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    status                TEXT NOT NULL,
    grant_id              TEXT,
    redirect_token_hash   TEXT NOT NULL,
    code_hash             TEXT,
    created_at            INTEGER NOT NULL,
    expires_at            INTEGER NOT NULL,
    code_expires_at       INTEGER
)

name: oauth_tokens
sql:
CREATE TABLE oauth_tokens (
    token_id     TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    node_id      TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nodes(node_id),
    grant_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES oauth_grants(grant_id),
    kind         TEXT NOT NULL,
    secret_hash  TEXT NOT NULL,
    resource     TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope        TEXT NOT NULL,
    expires_at   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    revoked_at   INTEGER,
    replaced_by  TEXT,
    created_at   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    last_used_at INTEGER
)

name: peers
sql:
CREATE TABLE peers (
    node_id      TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES nodes(node_id),
    role         TEXT NOT NULL,
    url          TEXT,
    perms        TEXT NOT NULL,
    paired_at    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    push_cursor  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    pull_cursor  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    last_sync_at INTEGER,
    revoked_at   INTEGER
)

name: project_repos
sql:
CREATE TABLE project_repos (
    project_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES projects(project_id),
    repo_key    TEXT NOT NULL,
    repo_prefix TEXT NOT NULL,
    checked_at  INTEGER NOT NULL
)

name: projects
sql:
CREATE TABLE projects (
    project_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    node_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nodes(node_id),
    abs_path   TEXT NOT NULL,
    slug       TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    event_id   TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (node_id, abs_path),
    UNIQUE (node_id, slug)
)

name: requests
sql:
CREATE TABLE requests (
    request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    node_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nodes(node_id),
    message_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES messages(message_id),
    thread_id  TEXT NOT NULL,
    title      TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agents(agent_id),
    owner_id   TEXT REFERENCES agents(agent_id),
    status     TEXT NOT NULL,
    due_at     INTEGER,
    note       TEXT,
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    claimed_at INTEGER,
    closed_at  INTEGER
)

name: resource_leases
sql:
CREATE TABLE resource_leases (
    lease_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    resource_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES resources(resource_id),
    node_id        TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nodes(node_id),
    agent_id       TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agents(agent_id),
    role           TEXT NOT NULL,
    ttl_seconds    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    renewed_at     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    expires_at     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    released_at    INTEGER,
    release_reason TEXT
)

name: resources
sql:
CREATE TABLE resources (
    resource_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    node_id        TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nodes(node_id),
    kind           TEXT NOT NULL,
    name           TEXT NOT NULL,
    endpoint       TEXT,
    port           INTEGER,
    pid            INTEGER,
    project_id     TEXT REFERENCES projects(project_id),
    purpose        TEXT,
    mode           TEXT NOT NULL,
    metadata       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    created_at     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    lapsed_at      INTEGER,
    released_at    INTEGER,
    release_reason TEXT,
    event_id       TEXT NOT NULL
)

name: sqlite_sequence
sql: CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)

name: tokens
sql:
CREATE TABLE tokens (
    token_id      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    node_id       TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nodes(node_id),
    agent_id      TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agents(agent_id),
    label         TEXT,
    project_globs TEXT NOT NULL,
    secret_hash   TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    expires_at    INTEGER,
    revoked_at    INTEGER,
    last_used_at  INTEGER
)

name: wake_targets
sql:
CREATE TABLE wake_targets (
    agent_id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES agents(agent_id),
    via        TEXT NOT NULL,
    target     TEXT NOT NULL,
    auto       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)
